scientific_disclaimer: All 500 multi-source events and all 1,524 network-flow records are 100% synthetic parametric benchmarks. No claim of real-world enterprise traffic performance or true zero-day detection on external PCAPs is made.

experimental_conditions.experimental_independence_disclosure: Track 2 (384 held-out network flows) enforces strict train/validation/test separation (840 train_normal, 180 val_normal, 120 supervised_attack_train, 384 test_set with zero SHA-256 record overlap). Track 1 (500 multi-source system events across S01-S10) is a deterministic rule/sensor/ML evaluation stream without separate training/test splits for NIDS/Honeypot/Correlation rules, paired sequentially with the unfiltered held-out test_set flows.

scientific_validity_and_limitations.synthetic_data_disclaimer: All 500 multi-source events and all 1,524 network-flow records are 100% synthetic parametric benchmarks. No claim of real-world enterprise traffic performance or true zero-day detection on external PCAPs is made.
scientific_validity_and_limitations.duplicate_polynomial_features: Features f_25..f_39 (15 columns) contain only 2 unique functions of (packets, duration), resulting in 13 duplicate columns.
scientific_validity_and_limitations.collinear_harmonic_padding: Features f_55..f_68 (14 columns) are linear scalar multiples of (packets + bytes)/(duration + 1), having rank 1.
scientific_validity_and_limitations.feature_collision_ambiguity: Preserved 4 cross-label feature-collision flows (2 normal, 2 attack) where identical (packets, bytes, duration) inputs produce identical 69-feature vectors.
scientific_validity_and_limitations.stage7_deterministic_sensor_coverage_lim: In the preserved Stage 7 500-event generator (S02-S10), 100% of malicious events carry either a Suricata NIDS signature_id (180 events) or a Honeypot interaction metadata object (180 events), plus one of 5 known external attacker IPs in KNOWN_IOC_CATALOG. Consequently, nidsHit || honeypotHit achieves 100% recall on S02-S10 in both Cohort D and Cohort E unless NIDS/Honeypot/Threat-Intel sensors are ablated (see track_1b_cohort_e_subsystem_ablations).
